command: daemon_pid=; workload_pid=; shutdown() { daemon_pid="${daemon_pid:-$!}"; workload_pid="${workload_pid:-$!}"; kill "$workload_pid" "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$workload_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap 'shutdown; exit 0' TERM INT; user_shell=/bin/bash; [ -x /bin/bash ] || user_shell=/bin/sh; grep -q '^[^:]*:[^:]*:1000:' /etc/passwd || echo "codewire:x:1000:1000:codewire:/home/codewire:${user_shell}" >> /etc/passwd; grep -q '^[^:]*:[^:]*:1000:' /etc/group || echo 'codewire:x:1000:' >> /etc/group; while [ ! -x /codewire/bin/cw ]; do sleep 0.1; done; /codewire/bin/cw __hosted-daemon & daemon_pid=$!; (exec 'sleep' 'infinity') & workload_pid=$!; while kill -0 "$workload_pid" 2>/dev/null; do if ! kill -0 "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null; then wait "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; daemon_pid=; /codewire/bin/cw __hosted-daemon & daemon_pid=$!; fi; sleep 1; done; wait "$workload_pid"; status=$?; kill "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$daemon_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; exit "$status"
containers.name: workspace

command:
docker_bootstrap_fail() {
  printf 'Codewire Docker startup failed: %s\n' "$1" >&2
  exit 1
}
cgroup_root=/sys/fs/cgroup
if [ -f "$cgroup_root/cgroup.controllers" ]; then
  IFS= read -r cgroup_type < "$cgroup_root/cgroup.type" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot read the Docker cgroup type'
  [ "$cgroup_type" = domain ] || docker_bootstrap_fail 'Docker needs a fresh domain cgroup; existing cgroups were left unchanged'
  mkdir -p "$cgroup_root/init" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot create the Docker process cgroup'
  printf '%s\n' "$$$$" > "$cgroup_root/init/cgroup.procs" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot delegate the Docker startup process'
  if IFS= read -r _unexpected_pid < "$cgroup_root/cgroup.procs"; then
    docker_bootstrap_fail 'the Docker cgroup root contains another process; it was not moved'
  fi
  IFS= read -r controllers < "$cgroup_root/cgroup.controllers" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot read available Docker cgroup controllers'
  for required in cpu memory pids; do
    case " $controllers " in
      *" $required "*) ;;
      *) docker_bootstrap_fail "the Docker cgroup lacks the $required controller" ;;
    esac
  done
  enable_controllers=
  for controller in $controllers; do
    enable_controllers="$enable_controllers+$controller "
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$enable_controllers" > "$cgroup_root/cgroup.subtree_control" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot enable Docker cgroup delegation'
  IFS= read -r delegated < "$cgroup_root/cgroup.subtree_control" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot verify Docker cgroup delegation'
  for required in cpu memory pids; do
    case " $delegated " in
      *" $required "*) ;;
      *) docker_bootstrap_fail "Docker did not receive the $required controller" ;;
    esac
  done
fi
data_image="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_IMAGE:-/workspace/.codewire/docker-data.ext4}"
data_root="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_ROOT:-/var/lib/docker}"
mount_mode="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_MOUNT_MODE:-loop}"
mkdir -p "$data_root"
if [ "$mount_mode" = "loop" ]; then
  if [ ! -s "$data_image" ]; then
    echo "the Docker data image $data_image is missing; the codewire-docker-data-init init container prepares it before Docker starts" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! awk -v target="$data_root" '$2 == target && $3 == "ext4" { found = 1 } END { exit found ? 0 : 1 }' /proc/mounts; then
    mount -o loop "$data_image" "$data_root"
  fi
elif [ "$mount_mode" != "none" ]; then
  echo "unsupported CODEWIRE_DOCKER_MOUNT_MODE=$mount_mode" >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$data_image" in
/workspace/.codewire/docker-data.ext4 | /mnt/home/.codewire/docker-data.ext4) ;;
*) docker_bootstrap_fail 'the commodity Docker data paths are invalid' ;;
esac
[ "$data_root" = /var/lib/docker ] && [ "$mount_mode" = loop ] || docker_bootstrap_fail 'the commodity Docker data paths are invalid'
[ ! -L "$data_root" ] && [ ! -L "$data_image" ] && [ ! -L "${data_image%/*}" ] || docker_bootstrap_fail 'the commodity Docker data path is a symlink'
data_device="$(awk '$2 == "/var/lib/docker" && $3 == "ext4" { print $1; exit }' /proc/mounts)"
case "$data_device" in
  /dev/loop*) loop_number="${data_device#/dev/loop}" ;;
  *) docker_bootstrap_fail 'the commodity Docker data filesystem is not a loop-mounted ext4 image' ;;
esac
case "$loop_number" in ''|*[!0-9]*) docker_bootstrap_fail 'the Docker loop device is invalid' ;; esac
IFS= read -r loop_backing < "/sys/block/loop$loop_number/loop/backing_file" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot verify the Docker loop backing file'
[ "$loop_backing" = "$data_image" ] || docker_bootstrap_fail 'the Docker loop device belongs to another image'
docker_store_marker="$data_root/.codewire-containerd-store-v1"
if [ -L "$docker_store_marker" ] || { [ -e "$docker_store_marker" ] && [ ! -f "$docker_store_marker" ]; }; then
  docker_bootstrap_fail 'the Docker format marker is not a regular file'
fi
if [ -f "$docker_store_marker" ]; then
  printf 'containerd-overlayfs-v1\n' | cmp -s - "$docker_store_marker" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'the Docker data format is unsupported'
else
  # Owner-authorized clean cutover: old Docker images, containers and volumes
  # are disposable. rm does not follow symlinks outside the Docker filesystem.
  for entry in "$data_root"/* "$data_root"/.[!.]* "$data_root"/..?*; do
    if [ ! -e "$entry" ] && [ ! -L "$entry" ]; then continue; fi
    if [ "$entry" = "$data_root/lost+found" ] && [ -d "$entry" ] && [ ! -L "$entry" ]; then continue; fi
    rm -rf -- "$entry" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot reset the old Docker data'
  done
  marker_temporary="$data_root/.codewire-containerd-store-v1.tmp.$$$$"
  (umask 077; set -C; printf 'containerd-overlayfs-v1\n' > "$marker_temporary") || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot prepare the Docker format marker'
  mv -f "$marker_temporary" "$docker_store_marker" || docker_bootstrap_fail 'cannot commit the Docker format marker'
fi
exec dockerd --host "unix:///var/run/docker/docker.sock" --group 1000 --data-root "$data_root" --feature containerd-snapshotter=true --storage-driver overlayfs
containers.name: dind

command:
set -u
# The three paths are overridable only for the script's own test; nothing
# renders them, and the pool policy admits no other variable.
dev="${CODEWIRE_MOUNT_WORKSPACE_DEVICE:-/dev/cwws}"
ws="${CODEWIRE_MOUNT_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-/mnt/ws}"
tmp="${CODEWIRE_MOUNT_WORKSPACE_TMP:-/mnt/tmp}"
volume="${1:-}"
began="$(date +%s%N)"
refuse() {
  echo "codewire mount-workspace: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}
subfolder=0
case "$volume" in
  new|existing) ;;
  new-subfolder|existing-subfolder) subfolder=1; volume="${volume%-subfolder}" ;;
  *) refuse "the volume state must be new or existing, optionally with -subfolder, not '$volume'" ;;
esac
dd if="$dev" of=/dev/null bs=4096 count=1 2>/dev/null || refuse "the workspace device $dev cannot be read"
probe=0
blkid -p "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || probe=$?
fstype=
[ "$probe" != 0 ] || fstype="$(blkid -p -s TYPE -o value "$dev" 2>/dev/null || true)"
ext4=0
if [ "$fstype" = ext4 ] || dumpe2fs -h "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ext4=1; fi
fresh=0
if [ "$ext4" = 0 ] && [ "$volume" = new ]; then
  case "$probe" in
    0|2|8) ;;
    *) refuse "probing the workspace device failed (blkid exit $probe)" ;;
  esac
  [ "$probe" = 2 ] || wipefs -a -q "$dev" || refuse "clearing the new workspace volume's chance signature failed"
  mkfs.ext4 -q -F -E lazy_itable_init=1,lazy_journal_init=1 "$dev" || refuse "formatting the new workspace volume failed"
  fresh=1
elif [ "$ext4" = 0 ]; then
  case "$probe" in
    0) refuse "the workspace volume holds '${fstype:-an unknown signature}', not ext4" ;;
    2) refuse "the existing workspace volume has no filesystem; it is not formatted" ;;
    *) refuse "probing the workspace device failed (blkid exit $probe)" ;;
  esac
fi
checked="$(date +%s%N)"
check=0
e2fsck -f -p "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || check=$?
[ "$check" -le 1 ] || refuse "checking the workspace filesystem failed (e2fsck exit $check)"
check_ms=$((($(date +%s%N) - checked) / 1000000))
mount -t ext4 -o noatime "$dev" "$ws" || refuse "mounting the workspace filesystem failed"
resize2fs "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "codewire mount-workspace: the workspace filesystem did not grow; it keeps its previous size" >&2
[ "$fresh" = 0 ] || chown 1000:1000 "$ws" || refuse "the fresh workspace root could not be given to the workspace user"
[ ! -L "$ws/.codewire" ] || refuse "the workspace's .codewire is a symbolic link"
if [ ! -d "$ws/.codewire" ]; then
  mkdir "$ws/.codewire" && chown 1000:1000 "$ws/.codewire" && chmod 0755 "$ws/.codewire" ||
    refuse "the workspace's .codewire could not be created"
fi
rm -rf "$ws/.codewire/tmp" && mkdir "$ws/.codewire/tmp" && chmod 1777 "$ws/.codewire/tmp" ||
  refuse "the workspace temporary directory could not be emptied"
mount --bind "$ws/.codewire/tmp" "$tmp" || refuse "binding the workspace temporary directory failed"
if [ "$subfolder" = 1 ]; then
  # /workspace is the filesystem's workspace/ folder (#4026). No workspace
  # process runs yet, so a folder checked here is the one bound.
  dir="${CODEWIRE_MOUNT_WORKSPACE_DIR:-/mnt/wsdir}"
  [ ! -L "$ws/workspace" ] || refuse "the workspace's workspace folder is a symbolic link"
  if [ ! -d "$ws/workspace" ]; then
    [ ! -e "$ws/workspace" ] || refuse "the workspace's workspace folder is not a directory"
    mkdir "$ws/workspace" && chown 1000:1000 "$ws/workspace" && chmod 0755 "$ws/workspace" ||
      refuse "the workspace's workspace folder could not be created"
  fi
  mount --bind "$ws/workspace" "$dir" || refuse "binding the workspace folder failed"
fi
if [ -n "${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_SIZE:-}" ]; then
  (
    CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_IMAGE="$ws/.codewire/docker-data.ext4"
data_image="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_IMAGE:-/workspace/.codewire/docker-data.ext4}"
data_size="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_DATA_SIZE:-8G}"
mount_mode="${CODEWIRE_DOCKER_MOUNT_MODE:-loop}"
if [ "$mount_mode" = "loop" ]; then
  codewire_dir="$(dirname "$data_image")"
  mkdir -p "$codewire_dir"
  chown 1000:1000 "$codewire_dir"
  # Owner-writable only: the workspace daemon refuses a group- or
  # world-writable ancestor of its platform session store.
  chmod 0755 "$codewire_dir"
  if [ ! -s "$data_image" ]; then
    # A fresh sparse image reads as zeros, so mke2fs skips zeroing its
    # inode tables and journal: a few MiB of writes at any size.
    if ! { truncate -s "$data_size" "$data_image" &&
      mkfs.ext4 -q -F -E lazy_itable_init=1,lazy_journal_init=1 "$data_image"; }; then
      rm -f "$data_image"
      echo "the Docker data image $data_image was not created; Docker does not start" >&2
    fi
  fi
  if [ -s "$data_image" ]; then
    # A grown workspace disk renders a larger data size: extend the image to
    # it, never shrinking it, and grow its filesystem offline to fill the
    # image. Growth keeps every byte, and a failed grow still starts Docker
    # at its previous size (#3554).
    data_gib="${data_size%G}"
    case "$data_gib" in ''|*[!0-9]*) data_gib=0 ;; esac
    if [ "$(stat -c %s "$data_image")" -lt "$((data_gib * 1073741824))" ]; then
      truncate -s "$data_size" "$data_image" || true
    fi
    data_fs_bytes="$(dumpe2fs -h "$data_image" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '$1 == "Block count" { count = $2 } $1 == "Block size" { size = $2 } END { printf "%.0f", count * size }')"
    if [ "$(stat -c %s "$data_image")" -gt "${data_fs_bytes:-0}" ]; then
      # resize2fs grows an unmounted filesystem only after a forced check;
      # e2fsck exits 1 when it corrected something.
      fsck_status=0
      e2fsck -fy "$data_image" >/dev/null || fsck_status=$?
      if [ "$fsck_status" -gt 1 ] || ! resize2fs "$data_image"; then
        echo "the Docker data filesystem did not grow to $data_size; Docker keeps its previous size" >&2
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi
  ) || echo "codewire mount-workspace: preparing the Docker data image failed; Docker reports it" >&2
fi
echo "codewire mount-workspace: mounted the $volume workspace volume (formatted=$fresh e2fsck_ms=$check_ms total_ms=$((($(date +%s%N) - began) / 1000000)))"
initContainers.name: mount-workspace

command:
# The path is overridable only for the script's own test.
ws="${CODEWIRE_WORKSPACE_FLUSH_ROOT:-/mnt/ws}"
flush() {
  began="$(date +%s%N)"
  status=0
  timeout 35 sync -f "$ws" || status=$?
  took=$((($(date +%s%N) - began) / 1000000))
  if [ "$status" = 0 ]; then
    echo "codewire workspace-flush: flushed the workspace (flush_ms=$took)"
  else
    echo "codewire workspace-flush: flushing the workspace failed (status=$status flush_ms=$took)" >&2
  fi
  kill "$sleeper" 2>/dev/null
  exit 0
}
trap flush TERM
while :; do
  sleep 3600 &
  sleeper=$!
  wait "$sleeper"
done
initContainers.name: workspace-flush
